tanoclo_ex.pairing_warning_title: Security Warning: RF Key Exposure Risk
tanoclo_ex.pairing_warning_body_1: TaNoClo is unable to send unique encrypted pairing messages to share the RF key because it lacks the device unique factory keys (K_NVM_34).
tanoclo_ex.pairing_warning_body_2: Enabling pairing mode will broadcast your network's operational RF key encrypted ONLY with the public static factory pairing key ("tado pairing key"). Anyone within 868MHz radio range can sniff your RF key while pairing is active.
